expected_behavior: Flags that tools/discord_tool.py keeps None for an unset discord.server_actions and adds a second None for an unset discord.server_actions_deny, so _available_actions and _run_discord_action each carry two None branches and the handler grows a second refusal gate. Asks to resolve the config once into the permitted actions (unset allowlist = every action in _ACTIONS, unset denylist = empty, permitted = allowed minus denied), which deletes the existing allowlist-is-None checks, the new denylist checks, the second gate, and the (allowlist, denylist) tuple, and says behavior holds because both paths only ever admit names in _ACTIONS.

review.title: feat(discord): turn off individual server actions with discord.server_actions_deny
